meta.title: 拍照❌“笑纹”尴尬，其实笑好看很简单
meta.title_en: Smiling in Photos: It's Easy to Look Good

scenes.context: 如果拍照是法令纹最简单的解决方式，那也一定是打光，但不可能时刻带着灯，那就让法令纹变得合理——笑起来。
sentences: 拍照是最简单的解决方式。
scenes.speak: Photography is the simplest fix. Make the folds look intentional.

scenes.context: 不笑的时候法令纹很凸显，一旦笑它的存在就变得合理，比一味抹平法令纹更耐看好看。
sentences: The folds stand out when you don't smile.
paraphrase: The folds stand out when you don't smile.
scenes.speak: The folds stand out when you don't smile. Smiling makes them more attractive.

scenes.context: 教大家一个方法：戴一个镜框去笑，找到苹果肌顶到镜框下面的感觉。
sentences: Practice with a pair of glasses frames.
Feel the apples push against the frame.
paraphrase: Practice with a pair of glasses frames.
Feel the apples push against the frame.
scenes.speak: Practice with a pair of glasses frames. Feel the apples push against the frame.

scenes.context: 通过嘴角的发力把苹果肌顶出来，脸显垮源于内沟和法令纹，而它们又源于苹果肌下垂。
sentences: 用嘴角把苹果肌顶出来。
Push the cheek apples up with the mouth corners.
Drooping cheek apples cause the sag.
paraphrase: Push the cheek apples up with the mouth corners.
Drooping cheek apples cause the sag.
scenes.speak: Push the cheek apples up with the mouth corners. Drooping cheek apples cause the sag.

scenes.context: 方圆脸多半嘴身不合，嘴巴千万不能咬合着笑，无论是否露齿牙齿都不能咬紧，要分开。
sentences: Round faces often have tense mouths.
Keep your teeth apart, not clenched.
paraphrase: Round faces often have tense mouths.
Keep your teeth apart, not clenched.
scenes.speak: Round faces often have tense mouths. Keep your teeth apart, not clenched.

scenes.context: 先用嘴角顶起苹果肌靠近镜框，牙齿不咬合，下颌找到发力的感觉并伸出来。
sentences: Lift the cheek apples with the mouth corners.
paraphrase: Lift the cheek apples with the mouth corners.
scenes.speak: Lift the cheek apples with the mouth corners. Extend the jaw and engage.

scenes.context: 如果还是觉得笑得很尴尬，先把嘴巴笑起来，再把眼睛展开，就会得到完美笑容。
sentences: Smile first, then open the eyes.
paraphrase: 用open the eyes换一种说法
Smile first, then open the eyes.
scenes.speak: Smile first, then open the eyes. You get a perfect smile.

practice: 用嘴角把苹果肌顶出来。
Push the cheek apples up with the mouth corners.
Keep your teeth apart, not clenched.
Smile first, then open the eyes.
